note: Coastal airport weather stations (NWS ASOS) read through the Iowa Environmental Mesonet: wind, gusts, direction, air temperature and pressure; no water sensors. They stand in for the open-water wind on the Connecticut shore while the buoys' weather is out, and to check HRRR against.

stations.name: Sikorsky Airport
stations.note: Airport weather station by the marshes at the mouth of the Housatonic, about 1 km from the Sound; anemometer 10 m above the field.

stations.name: Tweed-New Haven Airport
stations.note: Airport weather station on New Haven Harbor's east shore, about 1 km from the water; anemometer 10 m above the field.
